# FRED fixtures

Hand-built in the documented shapes of `fred/series` and `fred/series/observations`. Series ids
are real public-domain series (DGS10: Board of Governors H.15; UNRATE: BLS) but the observation
values are illustrative, not recordings. `TESTCOPY` is a made-up series whose notes carry a
copyright line, to exercise the license guard. Re-record trimmed live responses on the first run
with a FRED key (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md).
